items.item_text: CPA or other relevant financial certification
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Economics, or related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Master’s degree (MBA, MHA, MPH, or related field)
Minimum 8 years of progressively responsibility financial leadership experience, including staff supervision
Experience supporting academic medicine, faculty practice plans, or integrated health systems
Experience managing complex budgets in healthcare, higher education, research, or similarly complex environments

Join one of the nation's premier academic psychiatry departments and help shape the financial future of a world-renowned organization. The Department of Psychiatry and Biobehavioral Sciences is a leader in patient care, research, education, and community engagement, supporting a complex and diverse portfolio of clinical, academic, research, endowment, and philanthropic programs.

We are seeking a strategic and collaborative Director of Finance to provide financial leadership and operational oversight for the Department of Psychiatry and Biobehavioral Sciences. You will partner with departmental leadership to support financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and decision-making across the department’s clinical, research, and educational missions.
Lead strategic financial planning, forecasting, and budget development
Provide financial analysis and recommendations to department leadership
Oversee departmental operating, clinical, academic, gift, and endowment budgets
Develop financial models, reports, and dashboards
Ensure compliance with University policies and financial regulations
Expertise in financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, and strategic decision support
Advanced proficiency with financial systems, Microsoft Excel, and reporting and analytics tools
Strong knowledge of internal controls, financial compliance, and audit principles
Knowledge of faculty compensation models, clinical funds flow, and mission-based budgeting
Exceptional leadership, communication, relationship-building, and problem-solving skills
